title: Glucose and ketone readings
summary: Finger-prick meter readings, logged from a photo of the meter.
description: People on a ketogenic diet or a long fast watch blood glucose and ketones, and above all their ratio. A photo of the meter's screen is enough to log one.

requirements.text: Glucose is shown in the unit the meter showed it in (mmol/L or mg/dL).
A glucose and a ketone reading taken within `reading.pair-window` of each other show their glucose–ketone index (glucose ÷ ketones).
A reading outside the meter's measurable range is treated as a misread, not stored as given.
A reading's page shows a 30-day trend.
